entry.title: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering

entry.title: Can an LVLM Perceive Event Boundaries Like a Human?
entry.summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) reason effectively about video content, but whether they perceive its event boundaries in a manner consistent with humans remains unclear. entry.title: “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3
entry.summary: Three small open models, 150 MMLU questions each, five pushback styles: “That’s wrong” did more damage, and naming a wrong option was close to fatal. The post “Are You Sure?” Flipped Qwen2.5-1.5B’s Right Answer 2 Times in 3 appeared first on Towards Data Science.

entry.title: UMAP 0.6: new initialization, new optimizers and faster performance [P]
entry.summary: UMAP 0.6 is out! A new initialization, new optimizers, and faster nearest neighbour search make UMAP much faster and far better at large scale. On 3 million arXiv papers it finishes in under 5 minutes, before UMAP 0.5 has even found its nearest neighbours. (race between UMAP0.5 and UMAP 0.6 video) Code: https://github.com/lmcinnes/umap Install: pip install -U umap-learn (also on conda-forge) Speed
